_doc: task_hash policy contract. Decided 2026-06-11 per FABLE_BLUEPRINT F6. IRREVERSIBLE: any change to hash_inputs requires a corpus re-hash of exchanges/. Per MR-OD-029/030/031/032.
rationale: Semantic-hash chosen as the default. Content-hash alone inflated the corpus 6x (6 importers in llm_call_async share the same quoted email). Intent-hash leaks caller identity and requires documentation we don't yet have. Semantic-hash preserves the routing signal (per-model cost/training) without leaking caller. dedup_mode=first_wins because storage cost dominates and correction-mining wants the earliest stable signal; if a different mode proves better at scale, that is a 1-PR spec change plus a corpus re-hash.
compute_task_hash_signature: compute_task_hash(task: str, prompt_type: str, model: str, caller: str, session_id: str) -> str
